name: Wannaganosuchus
isnote: PBDB places it in Caimaninae; Wikipedia and the cladograms it cites treat it as a small alligatorid of uncertain subfamily.
sum: Small, short-armed alligatorid with crushing rear teeth from the late Paleocene of North Dakota.
wsnote: The skull is 159 mm long; no body length is given.
holotype: SMM P76.28.247 — a mostly complete skull and postcranial skeleton, Wannagan Creek, Billings County, North Dakota.
material: The semi-articulated holotype and a few small osteoderms.
biology: Its last teeth had broad, flat crowns for crushing; the forelimbs were short and the hindlimbs long.
author: Erickson 1982
